agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (~8.3, 8.9 Msun) with G=4.83 and dt=0.033 (near max) start 2.3 apart with one moving 3.98. By step 7 they are <1 apart, by step 8 distance 0.52, by step 9 distance 0.15 (< softening 0.3). Kinetic rises from ~66 to 929, potential from -148 to -1054. Even with 25 substeps at step 9, leapfrog integration cannot conserve energy for this deep, fast close encounter, causing energy to drift from -82.6 to -125.7 (delta 43 > allowed 39.7). Reducing dt to 0.005 removes the violation, confirming timestep resolution as cause.
